summary: stdcall mapper that translates an input enum value a2 in the range 1..22 into a translated literal 113..134 (a2 + 112) via a jump-table switch, writes the translated value to the record at a1+8 and the result of sub_414180(0) to a1+12, then returns 1. For any other a2 the record is left untouched and -1 is returned. Called from FontCharacterRenderDispatcher (00411DB0) and SoundEventDispatcher (00411E90); existing analysis suggests a sound-event mapping role but that is prose, not packet evidence.

local_names.a1: output record whose +8 and +0xC dwords are written on a matched case
local_names.result: return status: 1 on a matched case, -1 on default

operations.description: Initializes result to -1 as the default return status before the switch
Switch dispatch on a2 through the jump table jpt_414021: cases 1..22 reach the translation path, the default case returns result (-1) immediately without writing the record
Maps the case value to a translated literal: case 1..22 yields v3 = 113..134 (a2 + 112)
Writes the translated literal v3 to the dword at a1+8
Calls sub_414180(0) to compute a secondary value stored alongside the translation
Writes the sub_414180(0) result to the dword at a1+12
Sets result to 1 to mark a successful translation on the matched path
Returns result: 1 after a matched translation, -1 on the default path

unresolved: The semantic meaning of the translated range 113..134 and of the secondary value from sub_414180(0) is not evidenced by this packet (existing analysis suggests sound-event mapping, unverified)
Why sub_414180(0) is always called with the constant argument 0
The identity and type of the output record at a1 is unknown
